purpose: This table provides cleaned hourly ASOS weather observations for the three NYC airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) from January to June 2013, sourced from the Iowa Environmental Mesonet via the nycflights13 weather dataset, feeding downstream joins to flight data by origin and time.
usage: Join on origin and time_hour to attach weather conditions to flight records; consumers must handle nulls explicitly in wind_dir, wind_speed, wind_gust, and pressure rather than assuming zero or average values, and should expect wind_gust to be populated only about a quarter of the time.
limitations: wind_gust is missing in 74.6% of rows and pressure in 11.5%, with smaller gaps in wind_dir (1.7%) and wind_speed (0.02%); these nulls were retained rather than imputed, and the cleanup only covers the January-June 2013 window present in bronze, not a full year.
